fusions.name: Chaff Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses 4 husks at once, spread apart, each dealing 10 damage. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Stripped Stalk
fusions.desc: Fires a stalk stripped bare that deals 18 damage to one enemy, using up every affliction you have on it; each one used up adds 50% more damage.

fusions.name: Threshing Swarm
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm of seed-eaters for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Grain Gorge
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (20% at full) for 6 seconds. A stack fades every 10 seconds if none is added.
